privacy.title: Cookies and privacy
privacy.intro: This site doesn't collect personal data for analytics or advertising. This page explains the little it keeps in your browser.
privacy.storedText: A single cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, that remembers the language you picked (English or Portuguese) while your browser is open. It's needed for the site to open in the right language and doesn't identify you.
privacy.notStoredText: No analytics, ad pixels, cross-site tracking or forms that store your data. That's why there's no consent prompt: there's nothing to accept or decline.
privacy.controlText: You can delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. The site keeps working and goes back to picking the language from your browser.
privacy.counterText: If the site owner turned on the visit counter, each visit adds one to a total shown in the footer. Nothing about you is stored: no cookie, no IP address, only the number. Your browser remembers for the current session that you were counted, so reloading doesn't count twice.
